## Measurement Tools

::: {.accordion}

### Work Volition Scale
Measures individuals’ perceived control over career choice.  
Citation: Duffy et al. (2012)

### Decent Work Scale
Assesses five components of decent work.  
Citation: Duffy et al. (2017)

### Reproductive Autonomy Scale
Measures reproductive decision-making autonomy.  
Citation: Upadhyay et al. (2014)

:::
